## Guest Inbox

- The conversation now shows the newest message first, directly under Reply, so long threads do not start at the oldest email.
- Older messages stay in the thread, with a quieter style and a short date label when the day changes.
- Quoted history in a message stays collapsed behind “Show quoted text,” including Outlook “Original Message” blocks.
- Needs reply and who you reply to still follow the newest message by time, not the order on the screen.
